messages.subject: Helpdesk renewal — new pricing for 2026/27
messages.body:
Dear Ms Bello,

Your Helpdesk subscription is due for renewal on 1 July 2026. I am writing to share our new pricing ahead of the renewal: your annual fee will increase from €4,800 to €6,720, reflecting our updated per-agent rates and the platform improvements shipped this year (new reporting suite, SSO, expanded knowledge base).

If you renew before 15 June we can apply an early-bird discount of 5%. I would be happy to schedule a call to walk you through the changes.

Kind regards,
Marc Zuidema
Account Management, Helpdesk Co.

messages.subject: Helpdesk renewal +40% — time to look at Beacon Desk
messages.body:
Hi team 😊

The Helpdesk renewal just landed (below) and it's a 40% increase — €4,800 to €6,720. That's a lot for a reporting suite we barely use.

Good news: I've been trialling Beacon Desk for two weeks with a test project and it's genuinely better for us. Highlights:

- Native integration with our API — tickets auto-link to the customer's account and recent delivery issues, so I stop copy-pasting account numbers
- €5,400/yr for 12 agents, flat, no surprise uplifts in year two (in writing)
- Migration of our knowledge base is included; Beacon's rep says the historical ticket import takes a day

The team prefers it too — Ravi and Kofi both said the queue views are much faster. I'd propose we switch effective July 1, when the current term ends. Happy to walk anyone through the trial.

Aisha

messages.subject: RE: Helpdesk renewal +40% — time to look at Beacon Desk
messages.body:
Dear Aisha, dear Marta,

I have reviewed both proposals and on cost alone the case is clear: €5,400 flat versus €6,720 (or €6,384 with their early-bird) is a saving of roughly €1,300 per year against the renewal, and more importantly it removes a vendor who has just shown us a 40% uplift appetite. I can support the move from a budget perspective, subject to one condition: please obtain written confirmation of the second-year pricing before we sign, so we are not surprised again next spring.

I would gently add that July 1 is four days after the Ledgerly cutover on July 6 — apologies, I mean the cutover is July 6 so the support tool switch on July 1 lands just before it. During billing cutover week our ticket volume may spike, so I would ask that the knowledge base migration be completed and verified before June 27.

Kind regards,
Helen
Helen Oyelaran | Chief Financial Officer | Parcelwise B.V.

messages.subject: RE: Helpdesk renewal +40% — time to look at Beacon Desk
messages.body:
fwiw the beacon api integration is real, i poked their sandbox last week — ticket creation from our webhook took me an afternoon. migration looks fine too. only annoyance: their sso needs a config change on our side, an hour max.

no signature needed for this either ;)

messages.subject: Beacon Desk — formal quote request for 12 agents
messages.body:
Hi Femke,

Following our trial call — could you send the formal quote for 12 agents at €5,400/year, including: (1) written confirmation that year-two pricing stays flat, (2) the knowledge base migration at no extra cost, and (3) implementation support targeted for a July 1 go-live, with migration completed before June 27?

If all three are in the quote we're ready to proceed.

Thanks!
Aisha Bello
Head of Customer Success, Parcelwise B.V.

messages.subject: RE: Beacon Desk — formal quote request for 12 agents
messages.body:
Hi Aisha,

Quote attached and all three points confirmed in writing: €5,400/year for 12 agents, year-two price locked at the same rate, KB migration and implementation support included with go-live July 1 and migration verified by June 27.

One practical note: we'll need a read-only export from your current tool about a week before go-live — I'll coordinate the exact date with you.

Kind regards,
Femke Dekker
Customer Solutions, Beacon Desk

messages.subject: RE: Helpdesk renewal +40% — time to look at Beacon Desk
messages.body:
ok, beacon from july 1. aisha handle it. don't renew helpdesk.

M
Sent from my iPhone

messages.subject: RE: Helpdesk renewal +40% — time to look at Beacon Desk
messages.body:
Done 😊 Signing with Beacon today, and I'll decline the Helpdesk renewal before their June 15 early-bird deadline so there's no ambiguity. Femke — please count on the export around June 22.

Also, I promised the team we'd keep the old tickets archived read-only for a year — I'll confirm the export format with Beacon covers that.

Aisha
